Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Subodh Abhyankar
 On The 12 th Of July, 2024
Misc. Criminal Case No. 28054 of 2024

Rajesh
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 (Shri Vikas Parmar, Learned Counsel For The Petitioner)
 ( Shri Tarun Pagare, Learned Govt, Advocate Appearing On
 Behalf Of Advocate General)
 Order
1.
They are heard.
Perused the case diary/challan papers.

2. This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.476/2022 registered at Police Station Khipra,District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Section 376(2)N,450,506 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 27/06/2024.
3.Counsel for the applicant has submitted that it is a case of bail jump as the applicant was initially granted bail by the trial Court.

However, when the matter was fixed on 26.6.2024 for evidence of the prosecutrix, he could not mark his presence before the trial Court on 26.6.2024 and hence arrest warrant has been issued.
4.
Counsel for the applicant has submitted that because his vehicle broke down he could not attend the trial.
Subsequently, he has surrendered before the trial Court on 27.6.2024 and is in jail since then.
It is further submitted that the final disposal of the case is likely to take sufficient long time.
Thus, the application be allowed.

2 MCRC-28054-2024 5. Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand has opposed the prayer, and it is submitted that the applicant deliberately did not appear on the aforesaid date when the prosecutrix was to be examined with a view to further delay the trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case diary, taking note of the fact that the applicant was earlier granted bail by the trial C o urt, and that the applicant has already suffered 15 days for his nonappearance before the trial Court, this Court is inclined to allow the present application with a further direction that subsequently if it is found that the applicant has not appeared before the trial Court, the trial Court shall proceed in accordance with law and no further leniency shall be shown and without reflecting anything on the merits of the case
, the application filed by under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed.

7. The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he/she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
